lines.text: One class. Thirty children. *Thirty ways of learning.*
*Learnigo* gives every child the same practice, the way they need it: audio on every question, *no time pressure*.
Teachers *upload their own questions*. School admins approve them, and set up classes and timetables.
And you can see *every child's progress*: rounds, streaks and skills.
Private teachers *start free*. Schools, *talk to us*.
